verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵי֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְיוֹסֵ֔ף הִנֵּ֥ה אָבִ֖יךָ חֹלֶ֑ה וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶת־ שְׁנֵ֤י בָנָיו֙ עִמּ֔וֹ אֶת־ מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וְאֶת־ אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh way·yō·mer lə·yō·w·sêp̄ hin·nêh ’ā·ḇî·ḵā ḥō·leh way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- šə·nê ḇā·nāw ‘im·mōw ’eṯ- mə·naš·šeh wə·’eṯ- ’ep̄·rā·yim
verses.literal: Some time later . . . . . . Joseph . . . was told Your father is ill So he set out with his two sons Manasseh and Ephraim
verses.literalPt: Depois destas coisas, disse alguém a José: Eis que teu pai está doente. José levou consigo a seus dois filhos Manassés e Efraim.

verses.original: וַיַּגֵּ֣ד לְיַעֲקֹ֔ב וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּ֛ה בִּנְךָ֥ יוֹסֵ֖ף בָּ֣א אֵלֶ֑יךָ וַיִּתְחַזֵּק֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב עַל־ הַמִּטָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yag·gêḏ lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yō·mer hin·nêh bin·ḵā yō·w·sêp̄ bā ’ê·le·ḵā way·yiṯ·ḥaz·zêq yiś·rā·’êl way·yê·šeḇ ‘al- ham·miṭ·ṭāh
verses.literal: When Jacob . . . . . . was told Your son Joseph has come to you Israel rallied his strength and sat up in bed
verses.literalPt: Então, disseram a Jacó: Eis que teu filho José vem ter contigo; e, esforçando-se Israel, sentou-se sobre o leito.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יַעֲקֹב֙ אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֔ף אֵ֥ל שַׁדַּ֛י נִרְאָֽה־ אֵלַ֥י בְּל֖וּז בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַיְבָ֖רֶךְ אֹתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ ’êl šad·day nir·’āh- ’ê·lay bə·lūz bə·’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an way·ḇā·reḵ ’ō·ṯî
verses.literal: Jacob said to Joseph God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan and there He blessed me
verses.literalPt: Disse Jacó a José: O Deus Todo-Poderoso apareceu-me em Luz, na terra de Canaã, abençoou-me

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י הִנְנִ֤י מַפְרְךָ֙ וְהִרְבִּיתִ֔ךָ וּנְתַתִּ֖יךָ לִקְהַ֣ל עַמִּ֑ים וְנָ֨תַתִּ֜י אֶת־ הָאָ֧רֶץ הַזֹּ֛את לְזַרְעֲךָ֥ אַחֲרֶ֖יךָ אֲחֻזַּ֥ת עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay hin·nî map̄·rə·ḵā wə·hir·bî·ṯi·ḵā ū·nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā liq·hal ‘am·mîm wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ lə·zar·‘ă·ḵā ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā ’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: and told me Behold I will make you fruitful and multiply you I will make you a multitude of peoples and will give this land to your descendants after you as an everlasting possession
verses.literalPt: e disse-me: Eis que te farei frutificar, te multiplicarei, te tornarei uma multidão de povos e te darei em possessão sempiterna esta terra à tua descendência depois de ti.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֡ה שְׁנֵֽי־ בָנֶיךָ֩ הַנּוֹלָדִ֨ים לְךָ֜ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם עַד־ בֹּאִ֥י אֵלֶ֛יךָ מִצְרַ֖יְמָה לִי־ הֵ֑ם אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ וּמְנַשֶּׁ֔ה כִּרְאוּבֵ֥ן וְשִׁמְע֖וֹן יִֽהְיוּ־ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh šə·nê- ḇā·ne·ḵā han·nō·w·lā·ḏîm lə·ḵā bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim ‘aḏ- bō·’î ’ê·le·ḵā miṣ·ray·māh lî- hêm ’ep̄·ra·yim ū·mə·naš·šeh kir·’ū·ḇên wə·šim·‘ō·wn yih·yū- lî
verses.literal: And now your two sons born to you in Egypt before I came to you here shall be reckoned as mine Ephraim and Manasseh shall be mine just as Reuben and Simeon are mine
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, teus dois filhos, que te nasceram na terra do Egito antes que eu viesse ter contigo no Egito, são meus; Efraim e Manassés, assim como Rúben e Simeão, serão meus.

verses.original: וּמוֹלַדְתְּךָ֛ אֲשֶׁר־ הוֹלַ֥דְתָּ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֖ם לְךָ֣ יִהְי֑וּ עַ֣ל שֵׁ֧ם אֲחֵיהֶ֛ם יִקָּרְא֖וּ בְּנַחֲלָתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mō·w·laḏ·tə·ḵā ’ă·šer- hō·w·laḏ·tā ’a·ḥă·rê·hem lə·ḵā yih·yū ‘al šêm ’ă·ḥê·hem yiq·qā·rə·’ū bə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯām
verses.literal: Any children born to you after them shall be yours and they shall be called by the names of their brothers in the territory they inherit
verses.literalPt: Mas a tua prole, que tiveres depois deles, será tua; segundo o nome de teus irmãos, serão chamados na sua herança.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י׀ בְּבֹאִ֣י מִפַּדָּ֗ן מֵ֩תָה֩ עָלַ֨י רָחֵ֜ל בְּאֶ֤רֶץ כְּנַ֙עַן֙ בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ בְּע֥וֹד כִּבְרַת־ אֶ֖רֶץ לָבֹ֣א אֶפְרָ֑תָה וָאֶקְבְּרֶ֤הָ שָּׁם֙ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ אֶפְרָ֔ת הִ֖וא בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî bə·ḇō·’î mip·pad·dān mê·ṯāh ‘ā·lay rā·ḥêl bə·’e·reṣ kə·na·‘an bad·de·reḵ bə·‘ō·wḏ kiḇ·raṯ- ’e·reṣ lā·ḇō ’ep̄·rā·ṯāh wā·’eq·bə·re·hā šām bə·ḏe·reḵ ’ep̄·rāṯ hî bêṯ lā·ḥem
verses.literal: Now as for me when I was returning from Paddan to my sorrow Rachel died along the way in the land of Canaan . . . some distance . . . . . . from Ephrath So I buried her there beside the road to Ephrath (that is Bethlehem
verses.literalPt: Quanto a mim, vindo eu de Padã, com pesar meu, morreu Raquel na terra de Canaã, no caminho, havendo ainda alguma distância antes de chegar a Efrata; sepultei-a ali no caminho que vai dar a Efrata (esta é Belém).

verses.original: וַיַּ֥רְא יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מִי־ אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- bə·nê yō·w·sêp̄ way·yō·mer mî- ’êl·leh
verses.literal: When Israel saw the sons of Joseph he asked Who are these
verses.literalPt: Vendo Israel os filhos de José, perguntou: Quem são estes?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יוֹסֵף֙ אֶל־ אָבִ֔יו בָּנַ֣י הֵ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ נָֽתַן־ לִ֥י אֱלֹהִ֖ים בָּזֶ֑ה וַיֹּאמַ֕ר קָֽחֶם־ נָ֥א אֵלַ֖י וַאֲבָרֲכֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yō·w·sêp̄ ’el- ’ā·ḇîw bā·nay hêm ’ă·šer- nā·ṯan- lî ’ĕ·lō·hîm bā·zeh way·yō·mar qā·ḥem- nā ’ê·lay wa·’ă·ḇā·ră·ḵêm
verses.literal: Joseph said to his father They are the sons God has given me in this place So Jacob said Please bring them to me that I may bless them
verses.literalPt: Respondeu José a seu pai: São meus filhos, que Deus me deu aqui. Faze-os chegar a mim, disse ele, e eu os abençoarei.

verses.original: וְעֵינֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כָּבְד֣וּ מִזֹּ֔קֶן לֹ֥א יוּכַ֖ל לִרְא֑וֹת וַיַּגֵּ֤שׁ אֹתָם֙ אֵלָ֔יו וַיִּשַּׁ֥ק לָהֶ֖ם וַיְחַבֵּ֥ק לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ê·nê yiś·rā·’êl kā·ḇə·ḏū miz·zō·qen lō yū·ḵal lir·’ō·wṯ way·yag·gêš ’ō·ṯām ’ê·lāw way·yiš·šaq lā·hem way·ḥab·bêq lā·hem
verses.literal: Now Israel’s eyesight was poor because of old age he could hardly see Joseph brought his sons to him and his father kissed them and embraced them
verses.literalPt: Ora, os olhos de Israel se tinham escurecido por causa da velhice, de modo que não podia ver. José, pois, fê-los chegar a ele; ele os beijou e os abraçou.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֔ף רְאֹ֥ה פָנֶ֖יךָ לֹ֣א פִלָּ֑לְתִּי וְהִנֵּ֨ה הֶרְאָ֥ה אֹתִ֛י אֱלֹהִ֖ים גַּ֥ם אֶת־ זַרְעֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yiś·rā·’êl ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ rə·’ōh p̄ā·ne·ḵā lō p̄il·lā·lə·tî wə·hin·nêh her·’āh ’ō·ṯî ’ĕ·lō·hîm gam ’eṯ- zar·‘e·ḵā
verses.literal: I never expected to see your face again Israel said to Joseph but now God has let me see your children as well
verses.literalPt: Então, disse Israel a José: Eu não cuidara ver o teu rosto, e eis que Deus me fez ver também a tua descendência.

verses.original: וַיּוֹצֵ֥א יוֹסֵ֛ף אֹתָ֖ם מֵעִ֣ם בִּרְכָּ֑יו וַיִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ לְאַפָּ֖יו אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·ṣê yō·w·sêp̄ ’ō·ṯām mê·‘im bir·kāw way·yiš·ta·ḥū lə·’ap·pāw ’ā·rə·ṣāh
verses.literal: Then Joseph removed his sons from his father’s knees and bowed facedown . . .
verses.literalPt: José tirou-os dentre os joelhos de seu pai e prostrou-se com o rosto em terra.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח יוֹסֵף֮ אֶת־ שְׁנֵיהֶם֒ אֶת־ אֶפְרַ֤יִם בִּֽימִינוֹ֙ מִשְּׂמֹ֣אל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֶת־ מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה בִשְׂמֹאל֖וֹ מִימִ֣ין יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּגֵּ֖שׁ אֵלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ yō·w·sêp̄ ’eṯ- šə·nê·hem ’eṯ- ’ep̄·ra·yim bî·mî·nōw miś·śə·mōl yiś·rā·’êl wə·’eṯ- mə·naš·šeh ḇiś·mō·lōw mî·mîn yiś·rā·’êl way·yag·gêš ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: And Joseph took both of them with Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand and brought them close to him
verses.literalPt: Depois, levou os dois, a Efraim com a sua mão direita à esquerda de Israel, e a Manassés com a sua mão esquerda à direita de Israel, e fê-los chegar a ele.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל אֶת־ יְמִינ֜וֹ וַיָּ֨שֶׁת עַל־ רֹ֤אשׁ אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ וְה֣וּא הַצָּעִ֔יר וְאֶת־ שְׂמֹאל֖וֹ עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה שִׂכֵּל֙ אֶת־ יָדָ֔יו כִּ֥י מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה הַבְּכֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- yə·mî·nōw way·yā·šeṯ ‘al- rōš ’ep̄·ra·yim wə·hū haṣ·ṣā·‘îr wə·’eṯ- śə·mō·lōw ‘al- rōš mə·naš·šeh śik·kêl ’eṯ- yā·ḏāw kî mə·naš·šeh hab·bə·ḵō·wr
verses.literal: But Israel stretched out his right hand and put it on the head of Ephraim . . . the younger and crossing his hands he put his left on Manasseh’s head although Manasseh was the firstborn
verses.literalPt: Estendendo Israel a mão direita, pô-la sobre a cabeça de Efraim, que era o menor; e a mão esquerda pôs sobre a cabeça de Manassés, dirigindo as mãos assim propositadamente; pois Manassés era o primogênito.

verses.original: וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ אֶת־ יוֹסֵ֖ף וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הָֽאֱלֹהִ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ הִתְהַלְּכ֨וּ אֲבֹתַ֤י לְפָנָיו֙ אַבְרָהָ֣ם וְיִצְחָ֔ק הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ הָרֹעֶ֣ה אֹתִ֔י מֵעוֹדִ֖י עַד־ הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḇā·reḵ ’eṯ- yō·w·sêp̄ way·yō·mar hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer hiṯ·hal·lə·ḵū ’ă·ḇō·ṯay lə·p̄ā·nāw ’aḇ·rā·hām wə·yiṣ·ḥāq hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm hā·rō·‘eh ’ō·ṯî mê·‘ō·w·ḏî ‘aḏ- hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: Then he blessed Joseph and said May the God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked the God who has been my shepherd all my life to this day
verses.literalPt: Abençoou a José, dizendo: O Deus, diante de quem andaram meus pais Abraão e Isaque, o Deus que tem sido o meu pastor durante toda a minha vida até este dia,

verses.original: הַמַּלְאָךְ֩ הַגֹּאֵ֨ל אֹתִ֜י מִכָּל־ רָ֗ע יְבָרֵךְ֮ אֶת־ הַנְּעָרִים֒ וְיִקָּרֵ֤א בָהֶם֙ שְׁמִ֔י וְשֵׁ֥ם אֲבֹתַ֖י אַבְרָהָ֣ם וְיִצְחָ֑ק וְיִדְגּ֥וּ לָרֹ֖ב בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ham·mal·’āḵ hag·gō·’êl ’ō·ṯî mik·kāl rā‘ yə·ḇā·rêḵ ’eṯ- han·nə·‘ā·rîm wə·yiq·qā·rê ḇā·hem šə·mî wə·šêm ’ă·ḇō·ṯay ’aḇ·rā·hām wə·yiṣ·ḥāq wə·yiḏ·gū lā·rōḇ bə·qe·reḇ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: the angel who has redeemed me from all harm may He bless these boys And may they be called by my name and the names of my fathers Abraham and Isaac and may they grow into a multitude upon the earth
verses.literalPt: o Anjo que me tem livrado de todo o mal, abençoe estes mancebos; seja chamado neles o meu nome e o nome de meus pais Abraão e Isaque; e cresçam em multidão no meio da terra.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא יוֹסֵ֗ף כִּי־ יָשִׁ֨ית אָבִ֧יו יַד־ יְמִינ֛וֹ עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ אֶפְרַ֖יִם וַיֵּ֣רַע בְּעֵינָ֑יו וַיִּתְמֹ֣ךְ יַד־ אָבִ֗יו לְהָסִ֥יר אֹתָ֛הּ מֵעַ֥ל רֹאשׁ־ אֶפְרַ֖יִם עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar yō·w·sêp̄ kî- yā·šîṯ ’ā·ḇîw yaḏ- yə·mî·nōw ‘al- rōš ’ep̄·ra·yim way·yê·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nāw way·yiṯ·mōḵ yaḏ- ’ā·ḇîw lə·hā·sîr ’ō·ṯāh mê·‘al rōš- ’ep̄·ra·yim ‘al- rōš mə·naš·šeh
verses.literal: When Joseph saw that his father had placed his right hand on Ephraim’s head he was displeased . . . and took his father’s hand to move it from Ephraim’s head to . . . Manasseh’s
verses.literalPt: Vendo José que seu pai tinha a mão direita sobre a cabeça de Efraim, foi-lhe isso desagradável; levantou a mão de seu pai, a fim de a remover da cabeça de Efraim para a cabeça de Manassés.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יוֹסֵ֛ף אֶל־ אָבִ֖יו לֹא־ כֵ֣ן אָבִ֑י כִּי־ זֶ֣ה הַבְּכֹ֔ר שִׂ֥ים יְמִינְךָ֖ עַל־ רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yō·w·sêp̄ ’el- ’ā·ḇîw lō- ḵên ’ā·ḇî kî- zeh hab·bə·ḵōr śîm yə·mî·nə·ḵā ‘al- rō·šōw
verses.literal: Not so my father Joseph said - This one is the firstborn put your right hand on his head
verses.literalPt: Disse José a seu pai: Não é assim, meu pai, pois este é o primogênito; põe a tua mão direita sobre a sua cabeça.

verses.original: וַיְמָאֵ֣ן אָבִ֗יו וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יָדַ֤עְתִּֽי בְנִי֙ יָדַ֔עְתִּי גַּם־ ה֥וּא יִֽהְיֶה־ לְּעָ֖ם וְגַם־ ה֣וּא יִגְדָּ֑ל וְאוּלָ֗ם אָחִ֤יו הַקָּטֹן֙ יִגְדַּ֣ל מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וְזַרְע֖וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה מְלֹֽא־ הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·mā·’ên ’ā·ḇîw way·yō·mer yā·ḏa‘·tî ḇə·nî yā·ḏa‘·tî gam- hū yih·yeh- lə·‘ām wə·ḡam- hū yiḡ·dāl wə·’ū·lām ’ā·ḥîw haq·qā·ṭōn yiḡ·dal mim·men·nū wə·zar·‘ōw yih·yeh mə·lō- hag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: But his father refused I know my son I know he said He too shall become a people and he too shall be great nevertheless his younger brother shall be greater than he and his offspring shall become a multitude of nations
verses.literalPt: Mas seu pai, recusando, disse: Eu o sei, meu filho, eu o sei; ele também se tornará um povo, ele também será grande; contudo, seu irmão menor será maior do que ele, e a sua descendência se tornará uma multidão de nações.

verses.original: וַיְבָ֨רֲכֵ֜ם בַּיּ֣וֹם הַהוּא֮ לֵאמוֹר֒ בְּךָ֗ יְבָרֵ֤ךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְשִֽׂמְךָ֣ אֱלֹהִ֔ים כְּאֶפְרַ֖יִם וְכִמְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת־ אֶפְרַ֖יִם לִפְנֵ֥י מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḇā·ră·ḵêm bay·yō·wm ha·hū lê·mō·wr bə·ḵā yə·ḇā·rêḵ yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr yə·śim·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hîm kə·’ep̄·ra·yim wə·ḵim·naš·šeh way·yā·śem ’eṯ- ’ep̄·ra·yim lip̄·nê mə·naš·šeh
verses.literal: So that day Jacob blessed them and said By you shall Israel pronounce this blessing May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh So he put Ephraim before Manasseh
verses.literalPt: Assim, os abençoou naquele dia, dizendo: Por ti abençoará Israel e dirá: Deus te faça como Efraim e como Manassés. Desta sorte, pôs a Efraim adiante de Manassés.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֔ף הִנֵּ֥ה אָנֹכִ֖י מֵ֑ת וְהָיָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם וְהֵשִׁ֣יב אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֶל־ אֶ֖רֶץ אֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yiś·rā·’êl ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî mêṯ wə·hā·yāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘im·mā·ḵem wə·hê·šîḇ ’eṯ·ḵem ’el- ’e·reṣ ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: Then Israel said to Joseph Look I am about to die but God will be with you and bring you back to the land of your fathers
verses.literalPt: Depois, disse Israel a José: Eis que eu morro; porém Deus será convosco e vos fará voltar para a terra de vossos pais.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֞י נָתַ֧תִּֽי לְךָ֛ שְׁכֶ֥ם אַחַ֖ד עַל־ אַחֶ֑יךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר לָקַ֙חְתִּי֙ מִיַּ֣ד הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י בְּחַרְבִּ֖י וּבְקַשְׁתִּֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî nā·ṯat·tî lə·ḵā šə·ḵem ’a·ḥaḏ ‘al- ’a·ḥe·ḵā ’ă·šer lā·qaḥ·tî mî·yaḏ hā·’ĕ·mō·rî bə·ḥar·bî ū·ḇə·qaš·tî
verses.literal: And to you as one who is above your brothers I give the ridge of land that I took from the Amorites with my sword and bow
verses.literalPt: Eu te dou de mais que a teus irmãos um declive montanhoso, que tomei com a minha espada e com o meu arco das mãos dos amorreus.
